channel.title: Governance Digest: lido
channel.description: New DAO governance proposals and discussions, summarized in plain English.

item.title: LEGO Grant Proposal: RoundBeat for Lido community stakers (lido)
item.description: A LEGO grant request of $9,950 for 12 months to give small Lido CSM operators free access to a validator monitoring and alert service, plus two new views.

item.title: LEGO Grant Proposal: eth-hw-signer (lido)
item.description: A $40,000 grant request to build open firmware and a host service that keep Ethereum validator keys on dedicated microcontroller boards.

item.title: [Proposal] A new purpose, vision, and mission for the Lido DAO (lido)
item.description: Proposes a new Lido DAO purpose, 'Build the foundations for onchain finance', and a new mission, 'Make onchain finance simple, secure, and accessible'.

item.title: LEGO Grant Proposal: eth-dvt-signer (lido)
item.description: A one-person project asks for a $37,000 LEGO grant to build eth-dvt-signer, a threshold validator signer for on-prem AMD SEV-SNP hardware, in response to the Lido signer RFP.

item.title: RFP: open Ethereum validator signers for on-prem and isolated hardware (lido)
item.description: A Lido RFP invites proposals for open-source validator signers that keep keys inside hardware the operator controls, with grants expected well below $50k.

item.title: LEGO Grant Proposal: NOC Engine, Base L2 wstETH Peg-Defense Routing and Execution Telemetry (lido)
item.description: A team asks for a $10,000 LEGO Pebble Grant to build a wstETH peg-defense routing adapter on Base and a public telemetry dashboard.

item.title: Final Proposal (Version 2): Comprehensive Reporting and Audit Standards, Strategic Communications, and Budget Optimization for EGG 2027 (lido)
item.description: A Lido vote would mandate more detailed financial reporting and audits, and ask for 10-15% cuts to Lido Labs 2027 operating budget; early tally is heavily Against.

item.title: Final Proposal (Version 2): Comprehensive Reporting & Audit Standards, Strategic Communications, and Budget Optimization for EGG 2027 (lido)
item.description: A Lido forum proposal asks Lido Labs and the Finance Workgroup to publish fully itemised financial reports and audits and to build budget cuts into the EGG 2027 plan, instead of paying outside contractors now.

item.title: Expand the CSMC Mandate to Cover Additional Penalty Cases (lido)
item.description: Proposes letting the Community Staking Module Committee use the existing General Delayed Penalty mechanism for validator slashing and other protocol-harming incidents, not only MEV stealing.

item.title: Node Operator Admission: Galaxy Digital as stVault Professional Operator (lido)
item.description: Galaxy Digital applies to join Lido as an stVaults Professional Operator, citing existing client requests and a first stVault targeted for end of 2026 or early Q1 2027.

item.title: LEGO Grant Proposal: Preventing Theft in Mainstream Wallets with Vaults (lido)
item.description: Asks Lido's LEGO to pledge $30,000 toward a $240,000 effort to get mainstream wallets to ship spending-limited savings vaults that limit losses from stolen seed phrases.

item.title: LEGO Grant Proposal: Production-Ready Local-First Safe UI (lido)
item.description: Asks Lido's LEGO to fund part of a $120,000 open RFP for a self-hosted, open-source Safe multisig interface, so teams are not tied to the hosted Safe{Wallet} frontend.

item.title: LEGO Grant Proposal: Decentralized, Privacy-Preserving EDR (lido)
item.description: Asks Lido's LEGO for $30,000 toward a $300,000 open-source endpoint detection tool (EDR) for crypto teams, built by Auditware.

item.title: LEGO Grant Proposal: Assertions for Safes, Enforced on Every Transaction (lido)
item.description: Asks Lido's LEGO to put $10,000 toward a $75,000 Blossom Labs project that adds transaction-checking rules (assertions) directly to Safe multisigs.

item.title: LEGO Grant Proposal: Fixing Shared Problems Before They Turn Into Lost Funds (lido)
item.description: TheDAO Security Fund asks Lido's LEGO grants program to back four Ethereum security projects with $95,000 total, either sent now or pledged until each project is fully funded.

item.title: Funding and Mandating an Independent Web3 Financial Audit & R&D Expenditures (lido)
item.description: A community proposal asks Lido DAO to fund an external financial audit of 2024-2026 R&D, payroll and product spending, with a target budget of $150,000 and a hard cap of $400,000.

item.title: Mitigating Correlated Risk: Framework for Hybrid CSM Deployments and Provider Diversity Scoring (lido)
item.description: A Lido research post proposes a blueprint for Community Staking Module operators to run hybrid home and cloud setups, plus a provider diversity score, to cut correlated outage and slashing risk.
